heading: `logical: false` removes the TMS term from T_wcet
text:
### `logical: false` removes the TMS term from T_wcet [LNOG.7.2]

Under `realtime: true` with `logical: false`, the engine reserves nothing for
truth maintenance ([LNOG.4.1]), and the TMS term of T_wcet,
$c_{\mathit{tms}} \times 16$ ([LNOG.7.1]), is absent. A deployment's realtime
compliance checks lose their truth-maintenance item with it, so the checklist
for a `realtime` deployment with `logical: false` is strictly smaller than for
`realtime` alone.
